content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AAI Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AAI Medical Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AAI Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist) post is 21-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university as per Indian Medical Council/Government of India standards.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist) post is 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist) post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be paid Rs. 2700/- per working day for the first 6 hours, with an additional Rs. 500/- per hour for any extra hours worked.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this AAI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q9. Which region is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for the Regional Headquarters, North Eastern Region, LGBI Airport, Borjhar, Guwahati.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for easy access.
